text: Your agent can write the experiment.
It can compare the models, and score every answer.
But it can't rent its own GPU.
Ask for a benchmark, and the agent finds a machine under your budget.
It serves the model, and gets an endpoint back. No dashboards. No tickets.
And the GPU keeps billing. All night.
A watchdog runs on the machine itself.
Fifteen minutes without a request, and it shuts the GPU down.
Even if the agent forgot. Even if your laptop is closed.
Budgets the agent can't exceed. A maximum lifetime. Stalled hosts, replaced.
Your agent rents the GPU it needs, on its own.
You pay only while it works.
